name: FIR Convolver + A/V Sync
description: Applies a stereo pair of FIR impulse responses (separate Left/Right) to every video and audio player on every site, and delays the video image to compensate for the FIR's latency. Includes a low-latency EQ mode that mirrors the filter's magnitude with ~0 ms delay for players the full convolution can't run on. Resource-intensive by nature: real-time convolution plus full-quality video buffering wants a capable machine.
